n: 30" Electric Wall Oven and Microwave Combination
desc: The Frigidaire 30" Microwave Combination Oven with Fan Convection allows you to achieve faster, more even multi-rack baking results, all in an extra large, 5.3 cu.ft. oven cavity! It also features a premium touch screen digital control panel for the oven and the microwave offers convenient Sensor Cook and Auto Cook options.
hl: Get faster, more even multi-rack baking results with Fan Convection.
Self clean options available in convenient 2, 3 and 4-hour cycles.
Features a responsive 4.3 inch, full color, capacitive touch digital oven control panel.
Cook more at once with our extra large, 5.3 cu.ft. capacity oven.
Allows you to choose the specific broil temperature you want, ranging anywhere between 400 - 550 degrees.
Microwave sensors detect and automatically adjust power levels and cooking times for a variety of items, providing great-tasting results every time.
